text: Written in rows of 7, five of the copper's six doubled letters start in one column; experiment 56 showed that is not chance.
Each recipe enciphered 4,000 stretches of Carter's book and K1 to K3, and the experiment counted how often the doubled letters lined up as on the copper.
Ciphertext autokey at distance 1 with a 7-letter key does it 1.5% of the time, about five times a shuffled copper, but well short of the 5% the record predicted.
